neighbours.label: The Chinese token '有' (have/there is) when it is its own token, vs words where 有 is merged into a larger token (没有, 有的, 有很多) and other verbs
quiet: 公园里许多老人在下棋。
图书馆里的中文书很旧。

predictions: Sentences with standalone '有' 0.7-0.9; sentences with 没有/有的/有很多 merged tokens or no 有 under 0.06.
notes: Card: '有' is the peak of all top 32. Tokenizer: '有' alone is one token but 没有, 有的, 有很多 merge. Probe: 学校有三个 0.861; 有很多 (merged) 0.054, 没有人 0.026, 有的人 0.017, 是 0.019. Every fire item is tokcheck-verified to keep '有' as its own token.
